operator: A local plumbing-company owner or dispatcher responsible for after-hours service intake
customer: A homeowner calling after hours with a real service need
owned_value: A permissioned opportunity to respond to a real service need; never a guaranteed job
constraint: The unanswered call becomes an unprioritized voicemail while the homeowner continues searching

counter_system.operation: Preserve the caller token and call time
Classify routine, uncertain, urgent, or sensitive context without claiming certainty
Hold uncertain, urgent, or sensitive cases for operator judgment before a slot is offered
Offer the next appropriate available service slot
Suppress declined/non-consenting cases or create a measured scheduled appointment

outcome_object: A scheduled service appointment on a work-order card tied to the original call tag

persistent_objects.role: Customer signal carrying fictional caller token CALL-R01 and time 20:47

human_gate: An operator reviews every ambiguous urgency or sensitive case; those cases cannot reach slot offer while the gate is unresolved
guardrail: Declining or non-consenting customers leave the route immediately; no continued pursuit is shown or implied
honesty_tests: The call is shown as valuable permission to respond, not as revenue or a guaranteed job.
The homeowner may continue searching without being framed as disloyal or wrong.
Automation performs bounded routing; human judgment remains visible for ambiguous or sensitive cases.
A decline visibly terminates the route and suppresses further pursuit.
The only outcome shown is a fictional scheduled appointment in a labeled rehearsal.
The missed-call CSV is visibly synthetic and cannot be presented as evidence or a public claim.
